Synonym of athyroidism.
Relating to athyrosis
Of the nature of an aëtheogam.
ex: aëtheʹos (ἀήθης, unusual), in compounds = unusual ; aëtheogamʹic, aëtheogʹamous (γάμος, marriage), synonymous with cryptogamic.
